[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients for the filling include: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, 2 tablespoons butter, 1 medium onion, 2 cloves garlic, 2 medium carrots, 2 medium potatoes, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 cups chicken broth, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 1 teaspoon dried thyme, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients for the crust include: 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, and 1/4 cup ice-cold water.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for the chicken pot pie include preheating the oven to 375°F (190°C), cooking vegetables, adding chicken, and preparing the crust.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips and variations for the chicken pot pie include using leftover roasted chicken or turkey, adding frozen peas and carrots, using puff pastry, and making individual mini pies.
